$comment: Single source of truth for the Shortcuts RPC bridge. Agents read THIS to know what native iPhone capabilities are reachable — never 'whatever shortcuts happen to be on the phone'. One bridge shortcut (iU Bridge) dispatches on `verb` and POSTs results to the daemon's /agent/inbox. Adding a capability = add a branch to the bridge + add an entry here. Keep it small and curated.

bridge_shortcut.name: iU Bridge
bridge_shortcut.install: Add the one bridge shortcut (iCloud link in the README); it is the only shortcut you install. It reads a JSON request from the clipboard, dispatches on `verb`, runs the native action, and POSTs the result to http://<mac>:8787/agent/inbox with the Authorization: Bearer header.
bridge_shortcut.request: Daemon writes {"verb":"...","id":"<correlation>","args":{...}} to the Mac clipboard, then triggers 'iU Bridge' by name via Spotlight.
bridge_shortcut.response: POST {"id":"<correlation>","verb":"...","ok":true,"data":{...}} to /agent/inbox; the agent GETs /agent/inbox and matches on id.

verbs.native_action: Get Battery Level / Get Battery State

planned.note: side-effectful — confirm with the user first
